name: What are the most durable and cost-effective materials for a rental property bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What are the most durable and cost-effective materials for a rental property bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: For rental properties, durability and ease of maintenance are key. Porcelain or ceramic tiles are excellent choices for floors and shower surrounds due to their resistance to water, scratches, and stains. For countertops, laminate or engineered quartz offer good durability and a clean look without the higher cost or maintenance of natural stone. Simple, robust fixtures and hardware made from chrome or brushed nickel also withstand frequent use and are easy to clean.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain or ceramic tiles are durable and cost-effective for floors and showers. Laminate or engineered quartz are good countertop options, and chrome or brushed nickel fixtures are easy to maintain.
